title: svelte-ui-kit kit.json (v1)
description: Desired installation configuration. Unknown fields, coercion, default injection and unknown-property removal are intentionally disabled; absent optional fields receive the documented defaults.

schemaVersion.description: Local configuration schema revision. Independent of any framework release.

toolVersion.description: SemVer of the CLI that last wrote this configuration.

registry.description: Only the bundled registry is supported.

uiDir.description: Logical root for generated UI source, relative to the application package.

layoutFile.description: Logical SvelteKit root layout that imports the stylesheets.

requested.description: Explicit root item requests only; dependency closure is never stored here.
